name: DUMBBELL SEATED IN & OUTS
introduce:
Sit with your legs straight and your arms at your sides supporting on the ground. Put a dumbbell between your feet. 

Lean your upper body back. Lift your legs and upper body to bring your knees and chest to close each other. 

Fully extend your legs and lower your upper body without touching the ground. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it slowly to feel the squeeze in your abs.
Squeeze your abs with each crunch.
Exhale as you crunch, and inhale as you stretch out.
This exercise works your rectus abdominis and quadriceps.
